english.title: Affix to container of regulated produce / produce itself / certificate in a form prescribed
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without lawful authority affixed a label in a form prescribed for the purposes of

(A)_[section 13(2) of the Agriculture and Horticulture Act 1964]_
(B)_[a provision of an enactment of the Parliament of Northern Ireland, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ENACTMENT..), which was in force at the time and corresponded to section 13(2) of the Agriculture and Horticulture Act 1964]_

to

(C)_[a container of regulated produce,]_
(D)_[produce,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE PRODUCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 14(4)(b) and 20(2) of the Agriculture and Horticulture Act 1964.

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time Limit on Prosecutions
six months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
